content_blocks.text: The old lighthouse stood as a sentinel on the cliff, its beam slicing through the dense fog that clung to the coastline like a shroud. In the distance, the sea churned with an eerie rhythm, almost as if it were whispering secrets. The wind howled around the base of the tower, carrying with it the faint scent of salt and decay. As the first light of dawn began to break over the horizon, the lighthouse keeper, Mr. Hawthorne, climbed the winding staircase to the top, his flashlight cutting through the mist. He knew the fog would soon lift, revealing the truth that lay hidden beneath the waves.
